name: Daggerfall Online
summary: Daggerfall Online is a fan-created MMORPG experience set in the world of High Rock, inspired by the classic province featured in The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall. Explore vast medieval landscapes, uncover ancient mysteries, battle dangerous creatures, and forge your own path through political intrigue and regional conflicts. Featuring quests, dungeons, world events, and progression systems designed for cooperative play, Daggerfall Online reimagines one of Tamriel's most iconic regions for a new generation of adventurers.
